verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence show Cline can take plain-language instructions, create/edit files, run commands, and produce diffs across a codebase autonomously (cline-docs-1, cline-docs-4, cline-docs-11, cline-gh-1), and hands-on users confirm it working well on real multi-file tasks ('set it loose on my codebase... diff is almost always completely on the money', cline-comm-3; cline-comm-1, cline-comm-10). Missing for 10: rigorous independent benchmarks on complex multi-file bug fixes and more consistent community consensus (some reviewers rate rivals like Claude Code or Cursor as needing fewer prompts, cline-comm-4).
